tail_screening.definition: Concentration flag >=0.8; target intervals from original integer counts, with bitwise current-label normalization check and FP32 sensitivity comparison. Intervals for phi<-5 or phi>5 use no open-tail centers. Query endpoints are strictly inside bins, avoiding producer-boundary atom ambiguity.
tail_screening.not_the_historical_extreme_rule: Source-population percentile and old AF physical field are unavailable here. Conditional[-60,60) changes only the measure on this Atlas distribution; it does not recreate old AF computations. No claim of full extreme-screening validation.
tail_screening.no_false_precision: Intervals are sharp over arbitrary within-bin mass allocations, not confidence intervals or proofs of physically realizable alternatives; row/T/group presence counts may overlap for categories.
